def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    import re
    # Find the starting value and number of iterations from inputs
    text = str(inputs)
    # Try to get from known keys first
    start = None
    iters = None
    # Look for numeric values in inputs dict
    for k, v in inputs.items():
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            if start is None:
                start = int(v)
            elif iters is None:
                iters = int(v)
    # Fallback: parse from any string representation
    nums = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'\d+', text)]
    if start is None or iters is None:
        # heuristic: large number is start, small is iterations
        if nums:
            big = max(nums)
            start = big
            # find a small count (typically < 1000)
            smalls = [n for n in nums if n != big and n < 100000]
            iters = smalls[-1] if smalls else 1
    mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
    X = start & mask
    for _ in range(iters):
        X ^= (X << 13) & mask
        X &= mask
        X ^= (X >> 9)
        X &= mask
        X ^= (X << 17) & mask
        X &= mask
    return float(X)
